documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in managed services. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing managed services client of Cedar Systems who is currently experiencing workflow issues following a configuration change. The customer explicitly states this is a support incident and requests that support be involved before any discussion of expansion. The operational friction they describe is that 'workflow stopped after a configuration change.'
raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your workflow has stopped after a configuration change, and we appreciate your clarification that this is a support incident. Our support team is ready to assist you with resolving this issue. Please provide them with any additional details you believe would be helpful in diagnosing the problem.
questions: Can you provide the specific details of the configuration change that caused the workflow to stop?
Have you already contacted the support team, or would you like us to connect you with them directly?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change that caused the workflow to stop is not specified.
